appDesc.message: Detects how likely page content (text, images, video) is AI-generated using Chrome's built-in AI, and notifies you above a threshold.

st_unsupported_body.message: This browser does not support Chrome built-in AI (Prompt API). Chrome 138 or later is required.

st_download_body.message: The built-in AI model used for detection has not been downloaded yet. Download it from settings.

st_notYet_body.message: Press Analyze to scan this page.

st_skipped_default.message: The page text is too short.

st_unavailable_body.message: The built-in AI model is currently unavailable.

st_notHttp_body.message: Works on regular web pages (http / https).

media_empty_body.message: No sufficiently large images or videos were found on this page.

media_download_body.message: Analyzing images needs the multimodal built-in AI model. Download it to continue.

media_disabled_body.message: You can enable it in settings.

opt_model_desc.message: Detection uses Chrome built-in AI running on your device. The model must be downloaded once.

opt_model_available_hint.message: The model is ready on your device. All analysis runs locally.

opt_model_downloadable_hint.message: A model download (hundreds of MB or more) is required to start detection.

opt_model_downloading_hint.message: Fetching the model. Please wait until it completes.

opt_model_unsupported_hint.message: This browser does not support built-in AI (Prompt API). Chrome 138+ is required. See the Prompt API documentation for details.

opt_model_unavailable_hint.message: Hardware requirements are not met, or it is disabled by policy.

opt_threshold_hint.message: When the AI score is at or above this value, content is flagged as likely AI-generated and a notification is shown.

opt_autoAnalyze_s.message: Analyze each page's text automatically when opened.

opt_media_s.message: When you open the popup, analyze the page's media for AI generation.

opt_notify_s.message: Show a notification when the threshold is exceeded.

opt_popupAlert_s.message: When the score exceeds the threshold, open the same window as clicking the toolbar icon.

opt_badge_s.message: Show the score as a number on the icon.

opt_testNotif_s.message: Send a sample notification to verify your OS permission settings.

opt_testNotif_ok.message: Sent. If nothing appears, allow Chrome notifications in your OS settings.

opt_minChars_hint.message: Pages shorter than this are skipped.

opt_footer.message: probability v1.1.0 — Results are estimates based on style and appearance, and are not definitive.

notif_media_msg.message: {count} of {total} media items are likely AI-generated.
